fullPassage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.

questions.passage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers.

(B) Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention.
(C) The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark.

det.korean: (B)→(A)→(C): 소리 신호 → 형체 발견 → 정체 확인 순서
det.analysis:
✅ ① (B) — 금속 소리 + 다이브마스터 신호
✅ ② (A) — 신호 후 가리킴 + 지느러미 출현
✅ ③ (C) — 특징으로 정체 확인 = 망치상어
det.tip: 사건 흐름: 신호(B) → 목격(A) → 식별(C)

다이브마스터 중 한 명이 모두의 주의를 끌기 위해 그녀의 탱크를 두드렸다.

questions.wa: One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention.

✅ to get everyone's attention — 목적 to부정사

[made / the unmistakable rectangular feature / to identify / it easy / the enormous creature / swimming nearby]
questions.ans: The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby.
questions.wa: The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby.

det.korean: make + 가목적어(it) + 형용사(easy) + 진목적어(to identify...): 5형식 구조
det.analysis:
✅ made it easy to identify — 5형식: make+O+OC+진목적어
✅ the enormous creature swimming nearby — 목적어 + 현재분사구
det.tip: make it easy to V = V하기 쉽게 만들다 (it은 가목적어, to V는 진목적어)

questions.passage: Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞게 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.

Ann Marie는 그 순간이 계속되게 할 방법이 있기를 바랐다.
[Ann Marie / there was / wished / a way / to make / the moment / last]
questions.ans: Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.
questions.wa: Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.

det.korean: wished + that절(there was a way) + to부정사(to make) + 사역(last)
det.analysis:
✅ wished there was — wish + 가정법 과거 (there was)
✅ a way to make — way를 수식하는 to부정사
✅ to make the moment last — make+O+원형: 사역동사
det.tip: wish + 과거시제 = 현재 이루어지지 않는 소망. make+O+동사원형 = 사역
